## Personality

Bustling, bossy and warm. She shops like a general on campaign and expects the crowd to mind her baskets.

## Story

Maud keeps house for Dame Orsa and is at the market every dawn for eggs, bread and the best fruit in Selsior. She swears the market opens at dawn and closes only when the stalls run out, and she means to be there for both.

## Relationships

- [Dame Orsa](orsa.md): employer
- [Biscuit](biscuit.md): favourite dog
- [Margery](margery.md): friend
